name: Inspect
description: Passive knowledge of items, creatures, and objects. Reveals the true names of unidentified items at a glance.

name: Foraging
description: You can gather herbs and plants from the wilderness.

name: First Aid
description: Use basic medical knowledge to restore 10 HP without a potion.

name: Tracking
description: You can identify creature signs and paths in the wild.

name: Persuasion
description: Your words carry more weight. Unlocks dialogue options requiring social skill.

name: Intimidation
description: Fear is a tool. Some enemies hesitate on first contact.

name: Lockpicking
description: Open locked containers and doors without a key.

name: Trap Detection
description: You notice tripwires and pressure plates before they notice you.

name: Backstab
description: Attack from stealth for double damage. Requires AGI >= 10.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Passive +2 damage with your equipped weapon.

name: Shield Block
description: Actively block the next incoming attack, reducing damage by 50%.

name: Berserker Rage
description: Enter a rage state: +20% damage, -10% defense for 5 turns.
